input.summary: Add TrueLink IP/misconduct indemnity with defence procedure and narrow Client's indemnity to Client Content and Client's legal violations.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position requires TrueLink to defend and indemnify us and our affiliates against third-party IP infringement claims and claims arising from its breach of law, data breaches it causes and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with the usual notice, control and cooperation mechanics; we have added that as Section 12.c. We have also narrowed our own indemnity to Client Content and our violations of law, which is the only Client-side exposure we can accept.

ops.text: c. TrueLink shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Interface, the related software, the Hosting Services or the Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, (ii) TrueLink's violation of any applicable law, rule or regulation, (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or Credit Data caused by TrueLink, or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The party seeking indemnification under this Section 12 shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim, the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim, and the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation in such defense.

ops.oldText: (i) any claim arising out of any breach by Client of this Agreement, (ii) any claim or demand resulting from any act or omission by Client or any customer of Client granted access to the Interface by Client which constitutes a breach of or default by TrueLink under any System Agreement or Credit Repository Agreement, which breach or default has either not been cured or cannot be cured within the applicable cure period and the consequences of which is that TrueLink will lose material rights it has pursuant to said Agreements or a violation of any state or federal law, rule or regulation (iii) any claim arising out of or relating to the Web Site or Client Content (including, but not limited to, any claim resulting from any content posted to the Web Site by Client or Client's employees, agent or any customer of Client granted access to the Interface by Client), without regard to any knowledge limitation or qualification that may be contained in this Agreement, and (iv) injury or damage to person or property caused by a product, service, or information, whether or not defective, that is sold, distributed or transmitted from the Web Site.
ops.newText: (i) any claim arising out of or relating to the Client Content, and (ii) any violation by Client of any applicable state or federal law, rule or regulation.
